ManagedPdfRemovalTests.test_approved_sur.note: It ran INV-STORAGE-002 over the real backend/work_deletion.py, whose survivor-aware _remove_managed_pdf and retry_pending_pdf_cleanup were the SQLite capabilities to unlink a managed PDF. PG-C2 deleted that module. On PostgreSQL a managed file is an immutable object removed only by the cleanup settle, which re-checks every reference under the per-object lock; the replacements assert that. The rule itself stays covered by the synthetic-source tests of this class.
